result:
Comments, deletion, reporting and auto-hiding are in. `bun run typecheck` passes, and `guren check` shows 0 failures and 5 warnings; I didn't read the warnings. I didn't run the app or write tests, so none of the new behaviour has been exercised.

- **Storage:** `comments` and `comment_reports` are added in `db/schema.ts`, with a unique `(comment_id, user_id)` pair on reports. The migration is `db/migrations/20261019042201_add_comments`. Both tables cascade on delete in the schema.
- **Models:** `Comment` (with an `author` relation) and `CommentReport` are new, plus a `CommentResource` that shapes `{ id, body, author: { id, name }, createdAt }`.
- **Endpoints:** `app/Http/Controllers/CommentController.ts` handles the three endpoints, all behind the existing `auth` middleware so guests go to `/login`.
  - `POST /posts/:id/comments` validates the body at 1–2000 characters and redirects to the post.
  - `DELETE /comments/:id` lets only the comment's author or the post's author delete it; anyone else gets 403.
  - `POST /comments/:id/report` always answers 204 and stores one report per user.
  - The new routes are in `routes/web.ts`.
- **Post page:** `PostController.show` now passes `comments`, oldest first. It leaves out any comment with three or more distinct reporters, but those comments stay in the database.
- **Post deletion:** `PostController.destroy` deletes a post's reports and comments before the post itself.
- **UI:** `posts/Show.tsx` lists the comments, shows a comment box when signed in or a sign-in link when not, and shows Delete where it's allowed and Report for any signed-in viewer.

The Report button posts through Inertia's `router.post`, and the 204 reply is untested in the browser.
